description: baseline with a BFP4 LoFi LM head
ccl_note: one chip (stages 4 and 5 skipped by the operator): no collectives, no CCL activations

logits.decode_note: LM head decode output [1, 1, 32, padded_vocab] BF16 with the padded columns at bf16 min

sampling.path: models/common/sampling SamplingGenerator over the BF16 logits tile (top-k path, k=1 for greedy)

acceptance.rule: pass requires the bar on the main AIME24 reference (prefill check and teacher forcing) and on every robustness reference the candidate was evaluated on (second AIME24 prompt, 32-token short-prefix book prompt, 1468 natural-text positions of prefill logits against HF fp32 logits); every candidate faster than the selected one has at least one recorded failing reference, and every faster candidate that passed its main reference and the short prefix was also run on natural text

teacher_forcing.timing_regime: serialized: the only device job on the host during this run (fuser checked on chips 0, 1 and 2 before the chain)

natural_text.reference: tale-of-two-cities tokens [32, 1500): TT prefill logits (prefill path, LM head LoFi fp32 acc) against HF fp32 logits at 1468 real next-token positions

selection.hardware: one Blackhole P300 chip (TT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2), 1x1 mesh, p150 mesh graph descriptor
selection.mesh: N150 (1x1); stages 4 and 5 skipped by the operator, single chip is the target topology
selection.restore_baseline: QWEN3_PRECISION_CONFIG=models/autoports/qwen_qwen3_8b/doc/datatype_sweep/configs/c0_stage7_baseline.json (or delete this file: build_generator then uses the built-in stage-7 baseline)
selection.consumed_by: models/autoports/qwen_qwen3_8b/tt/generator.py::build_generator via tt/precision.py (default path when QWEN3_PRECISION_CONFIG is unset); propagation evidence in propagation_check_selected_36.json

runtime_flags.QWEN3_PRECISION_CONFIG: path of a precision config to use instead of this file
runtime_flags.QWEN3_LM_HEAD_DECODE_FIDELITY, QWEN3_LM_: terminal-policy overrides applied on top of the config
runtime_flags.QWEN3_PREFILL_KERNEL_TABLE, QWEN3_PREFIL: prefill kernel overrides applied on top of the config (not dtype policy)
